item.title: J&J Snack Foods CEO on 4Q Results and Consumer Sentiment
item.description: J&J Snack Foods CEO Dan Fachner said the company’s turnaround is on track after a strong year, citing Project Apollo’s more than $25 million in durable savings. A second phase, Apollo 2, is expected to generate another $5 million by 2027 through distribution and manufacturing improvements. Fachner speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: ‘Always Remain Liquid’: Richards
item.description: Bruce Richards, managing partner and head of CVC Marathon, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on “Bloomberg Money.” They discuss Richards’ favorite investing advice he has received throughout his career. Richards warns about irrational markets and also says he’s not a fan of leveraged ETF structures. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Anthropic Slides 8.5% to Shrink IPO Gain as AI Trade Unravels
item.description: Anthropic PBC shares erased a portion of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors’ faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.

item.title: Trump Says Huang Should Return to Nvidia After ‘Big Apology’
item.description: President Trump called for Jensen Huang to make a big apology and return as CEO of Nvidia even as the prospect remains highly unlikely. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: S&P, Dow Slide Into Correction as Investors Dump Tech
item.description: Chipmakers led a plunge in US stocks on Friday, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Index closing in correction territory. Carmen Reinicke reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
